_comment: DiscVault demo library for marketing screenshots. All titles, people, studios, barcodes, shops and prices are invented; barcodes use the GS1 in-store prefix 2.

films.title: Orbit of Ash
films.overview: The last surveyor of a dying mining world has nine days to decide whether its colony is worth saving.

films.title: Halcyon Drift
films.overview: A salvage pilot boards a generation ship that has been drifting above a quiet ocean world for two hundred years.

films.title: Neon Tidewater
films.overview: In a drowned port city, a ferrywoman is hired to find a passenger who never reached the other shore.

films.title: The Quiet Signal
films.overview: A night-shift technician at a remote observatory answers a signal nobody else can hear.

films.title: Parallax Nine
films.overview: Nine rookie pilots are sent past a double sun to bring back a squadron that vanished a generation ago.

films.title: Starling Protocol
films.overview: An air-traffic analyst notices that the city's drone swarm has started flying in patterns no one programmed.

films.title: Glass Meridian
films.overview: A disgraced courier has one night to carry a key across a city of glass towers before the buildings lock down.

films.title: Cold Harbor Run
films.overview: A trawler captain agrees to one last crossing and learns too late what is in the hold.

films.title: Vanta
films.overview: She was trained to disappear. Tonight someone has finally seen her.

films.title: Seven Minutes North
films.overview: When the lake ice begins to break, a rescue volunteer has seven minutes to reach a stranded research hut.

films.title: The Copper Line
films.overview: Two rival crews board the same mountain express, each planning to rob it before the last viaduct.

films.title: Night Freight
films.overview: A long-haul driver picks up a sealed trailer and a set of rules: no stops, no questions, no daylight.

films.title: The Last Lighthouse
films.overview: The keeper of the last manned lighthouse on the coast refuses to leave on the day it is automated.

films.title: Paper Orchards
films.overview: A daughter returns to the family orchard and finds her mother folding blossoms for trees that no longer flower.

films.title: Salt and Cedar
films.overview: Two estranged brothers spend a summer rebuilding the boat their father never finished.

films.title: Letters to Marrow Bay
films.overview: A postmistress starts answering letters addressed to a fisherman who was lost at sea.

films.title: The Understudy's Daughter
films.overview: Raised in the wings of a failing theatre, a girl learns every part her mother never got to play.

films.title: Small Hours
films.overview: One diner, one night, and the eleven strangers who come in between midnight and dawn.

films.title: Hollow Pines
films.overview: A search party follows a child's red coat into a forest that is not on any map.

films.title: Beneath Ashgrove
films.overview: The new owners of Ashgrove House find a staircase in the cellar that goes down further than the house goes up.

films.title: Saltmarsh
films.overview: At low tide the walkway leads to the old village. At high tide, something uses it to come back.

films.title: Whisper Mill
films.overview: A family restoring a watermill discovers why the wheel was chained.

films.title: Pip and the Paper Moon
films.overview: A small mouse folds a paper aeroplane and sets out to return a star to the moon.

films.title: The Clockmaker's Fox
films.overview: When the town clock stops on the longest night, a fox apprentice climbs inside to wind time forward again.

films.title: Captain Thistle
films.overview: A hedgehog with a walnut-shell ship sets sail across the pond to find the edge of the map.

films.title: Lanternfish
films.overview: The smallest light in the deep sea goes looking for the biggest one.

films.title: Second Tuesday
films.overview: Two strangers share the same park bench on the second Tuesday of every month and never say hello.

films.title: The Wrong Sofia
films.overview: A tired traveller is collected at arrivals by a wedding party that is expecting somebody else.

films.title: Plus One, Minus Two
films.overview: Table nine has three empty chairs and one very good reason for each.

films.title: Postcards from Nowhere
films.overview: A retired postman, his dog and a failing camper van try to deliver forty years of unsent postcards.

films.title: Dust of the Seventh Mesa
films.overview: A surveyor hired to redraw a border finds the last family living on the wrong side of it.

films.title: The Cartographer's Son
films.overview: A mapmaker's son sails to prove that his father's last map was not a forgery.

films.title: Ironwood Trail
films.overview: A scout leads a wagon train through a forest the old maps mark only with a warning.

films.title: Kingdom of Reeds
films.overview: A young queen must hold a river kingdom together with nothing but boats, reeds and patience.

films.title: Velvet Alibi
films.overview: Everyone at the Blue Door Club saw her that night. That is exactly the problem.

films.title: The Harrow Street Ledger
films.overview: A bookkeeper notices one number that should not be there, and cannot stop reading.

films.title: Blue Hour Motel
films.overview: Room six has been paid for through Sunday. Nobody has seen who is staying in it.

films.title: Counterfeit Saints
films.overview: A restorer and a forger have one week to swap six paintings before anyone counts the halos.

films.title: The Emberwood Crown
films.overview: The crown of the forest kingdom burns anyone unworthy to wear it. No one has been worthy for a hundred years.

films.title: Aurelia and the Wolf King
films.overview: To end the long winter, a girl walks north to bargain with the king of the wolves.

films.title: The Long Ascent
films.overview: Five climbers, one unclimbed ridge, and the winter that nearly kept them.

films.title: Vinyl Summer
films.overview: Three friends spend the hottest summer on record trying to press their own album.

films.title: The Iron Regatta
films.overview: A dockyard crew with a borrowed boat enters the one race they were never meant to see.

films.title: Radio Silence at Dawn
films.overview: A radio operator is ordered to stay off the air until sunrise, whatever he hears.

films.title: Meridian: Fracture
films.overview: The key opened more than one door. Now every reflection in the city is looking for him.

films.title: Meridian: Zero Hour
films.overview: At midnight the towers reset. One man is still inside the clock.

films.title: Starfall
films.overview: A farm girl follows a falling star across the desert and finds it was sent for her.

films.title: Starfall: Exile
films.overview: Hunted across a frozen world, the star-bearer learns what the light actually costs.

films.title: Starfall: Ironsong
films.overview: In the forge-city inside the hollow moon, an army waits for a song only she can finish.

films.title: Starfall: Twin Suns Rising
films.overview: Two suns, two heirs, and one day on which both of them rise.

films.title: Starfall: Homecoming
films.overview: The fleet comes home. The star-bearer has to decide whether she can.

films.title: Captain Thistle and the Sunken Bell
films.overview: Something is ringing at the bottom of the pond, and Captain Thistle has a diving helmet.

films.title: Captain Thistle: Sky Pirates
films.overview: When magpies steal the harvest moon lanterns, the Captain trades his ship for a balloon.

films.title: Captain Thistle's Winter Voyage
films.overview: The pond is freezing over, and one last lantern needs to reach the harbour before the snow.
